description: This source file defines a Roslyn analyzer class 'IdClashAttributeAnalyzer' that detects duplicate IDs in attributes for types (classes, structs, records) marked with a specific attribute. It analyzes syntax nodes to identify name clashes in attribute arguments and reports diagnostics accordingly.

classes.name: IdClashAttributeAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer class for detecting duplicate IDs in attributes within C# code, used during code analysis.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Analyzes a syntax node representing a type declaration to check for duplicate attribute IDs; reports diagnostics for duplicates.
